 FC Seoul captures first K League 1 championship in a decade 
 The team clinched the K League 1 title with five matches left in the season after drawing Gangwon FC 1-1.
 Published 
 October 24, 2026 - 4:45 p.m. 
 Make us preferred on Google 
 FC Seoul football players celebrate after scoring against Gangwon FC during the clubs' K League 1 match at Seoul World Cup Stadium in Seoul on Oct. 24 
 YONHAP 
 FC Seoul captured their first Korean football title in 10 years Saturday.
 FC Seoul played Gangwon FC to a 1-1 draw in their K League 1 match at Seoul World Cup Stadium in the capital city and improved to 67 points with five matches to play.
 Ulsan HD FC remained in second place with 51 points following their 2-2 draw with Pohang Steelers on Saturday and will not be able to catch FC Seoul the rest of the season.
 Teams were split into two tiers after Saturday's matches — the top six in Final A and the bottom six in Final B. They will then play five more matches within their own group to close out the season.
 FC Seoul became just the third team to clinch the K League 1 title with five or more matches left on the season under the current system, joining the 2018 and 2025 Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors.

Though Gangwon drew level seven minutes later on Kang Jun-hyuk's goal, FC Seoul still clinched their title with the draw as Ulsan, needing a combination of their win and a FC Seoul loss or draw, settled for a draw themselves against Pohang.
